sentences.japanese: 京都に久しぶりに大雪が降った。
sentences.english: A heavy snow fell in Kyoto for the first time in ages.

sentences.japanese: 久々に聞いたこの曲。なつかしい。
sentences.english: Hearing this song after so long really brings back the old times.

sentences.japanese: 久しぶりに彼は帰ってきた。
sentences.english: After a long absence he came back.

sentences.japanese: 久しぶりに昔の友人がひょっこり訪ねてきてくれた。
sentences.english: An old friend of mine dropped in on me for the first time in ages.

sentences.japanese: 久しぶりに会ったんだから、酒でも飲みながら、昔話にでも花を咲かせるとするか。
sentences.english: It's been so long since we last met up. Let's have a drink or two and talk about the good old days.
